source:
Create a highly addictive Roblox game called "SATISFYING FACTORY".

The game should be inspired by modern viral Roblox games with simple gameplay loops, satisfying animations, colorful visuals, funny sounds, progression, collecting and extremely satisfying interactions.

The main concept:

Each player owns a small factory.

Players collect basic objects from the map and bring them into their factory.

Inside the factory, machines automatically process the objects.

The entire processing system must feel extremely satisfying.

For example:

- Objects fall onto conveyor belts.
- Objects bounce, rotate and roll.
- Machines crush objects.
- Objects get cut into pieces.
- Objects get melted.
- Objects get compressed.
- Objects get transformed into better objects.
- Finished objects come out of the machines with satisfying sounds and particle effects.
- Coins pop out when objects are successfully processed.

Make the animations smooth and satisfying.

Add strong visual feedback:

- Coins flying toward the player
- Numbers appearing when money is earned
- Objects changing color
- Glow effects
- Sparks
- Small explosions
- Screen shake
- Combo effects
- Pop-up notifications
- Satisfying sound effects

GAMEPLAY LOOP:

1. Collect objects.
2. Put them into the factory.
3. Watch the machines process them.
4. Earn money.
5. Upgrade machines.
6. Unlock better objects.
7. Expand the factory.
8. Automate production.
9. Discover extremely rare objects.
10. Repeat and become the richest factory owner.

OBJECT RARITIES:

Common
Uncommon
Rare
Epic
Legendary
Mythic
Secret
Impossible

Examples of objects:

Apple
Toy
Rock
Glass
Diamond
Gold
Robot
Alien Crystal
Meteor
Black Hole
Rainbow Cube
Galaxy Core
Secret Mystery Object

FACTORY MACHINES:

Crusher
Cutter
Melter
Press
Laser
Recycler
Duplicator
Rainbow Machine
Galaxy Machine
Secret Machine

Each machine should have increasingly satisfying animations and effects.

UPGRADES:

Players can upgrade:

- Processing speed
- Machine power
- Conveyor speed
- Storage capacity
- Coin multiplier
- Critical processing chance
- Rare object chance
- Factory size

Add a prestige system called RESTART.

When players reach a very high factory level, they can restart their factory and receive permanent bonuses.

Add pets that follow the player and provide bonuses.

Pet rarities:

Common
Rare
Epic
Legendary
Mythic
Secret

Add eggs that players can open to obtain pets.

Add a large colorful world with several factory areas:

Starter Factory
Candy Factory
Toy Factory
Technology Factory
Volcano Factory
Space Factory
Galaxy Factory
Secret Factory

Each new area introduces new objects, machines and visual effects.

GLOBAL EVENTS:

Every few minutes, trigger a random server-wide event.

Examples:

MEGA OBJECT EVENT:
A gigantic object appears and every player can help process it.

GOLDEN RAIN:
Thousands of golden objects fall from the sky.

SUPER SPEED:
All machines become 10x faster for 30 seconds.

RAINBOW EVENT:
All objects temporarily become rainbow objects.

BLACK HOLE:
A black hole appears and starts sucking objects from the map.

SECRET OBJECT:
A mysterious object appears somewhere in the world and only one player can find it.

Add a collection book where players can discover and collect every object in the game.

Add a global leaderboard showing:

Richest Player
Highest Factory Level
Most Objects Processed
Most Secret Objects Found
Longest Play Time

Make the game extremely easy to understand within the first 10 seconds.

The player should immediately see:
COLLECT → PROCESS → EARN → UPGRADE → REPEAT.

Make the game colorful, polished, funny and highly satisfying.

Use smooth Roblox animations, excellent sound design, particles, physics-based object movement, screen effects and satisfying UI feedback.

The game should be optimized for mobile, tablet and PC.

Make the interface simple and modern.

The first 5 minutes should be extremely rewarding so new players immediately understand the progression and want to continue playing.

Add many small satisfying interactions throughout the game so that almost every action produces visual or audio feedback.

The goal is to create a Roblox game that feels extremely satisfying to watch and play, and that can generate viral YouTube Shorts and TikTok clips.

IMPORTANT:
Do not make the game complicated at the beginning. Start with one simple factory and gradually introduce new mechanics, machines, objects, pets, areas and events as the player progresses.

answers.ask: How big is one factory plot at full expansion, and are the eight areas one continuous world or separate places?
answers.answer: Use a compact factory plot that expands to roughly a 60x60-stud footprint at full expansion, enough for a clear automated production line without becoming overwhelming. Make the eight factory areas separate themed zones within one continuous world, unlocked in progression order.

answers.ask: Is the collecting ground shared by the whole server, or does each player have their own patch?
answers.answer: Use a shared collecting ground in each world area so players can see one another collecting and compete for rare spawns. Keep object respawns frequent so the shared space stays rewarding for everyone.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] scale — Q: How big is one factory plot at full expansion, and are the eight areas one continuous world or separate places? A: Use a compact factory plot that expands to roughly a 60x60-stud footprint at full expansion, enough for a clear automated production line without becoming overwhelming. Make the eight factory areas separate themed zones within one continuous world, unlocked in progression order.
- [author] shape — Q: Is the collecting ground shared by the whole server, or does each player have their own patch? A: Use a shared collecting ground in each world area so players can see one another collecting and compete for rare spawns. Keep object respawns frequent so the shared space stays rewarding for everyone.
- [agent_inferred] enclosure — Q: Are the production lines enclosed buildings? A: Use open-sided factory plots so players can immediately see the full automated process and no interior transition is required.

## Enriched image prompt
Create one large, continuous, colorful factory world with exactly eight compact zones in progression order: Starter Factory, Candy Factory, Toy Factory, Technology Factory, Volcano Factory, Space Factory, Galaxy Factory, and Secret Factory. Link neighboring zones with a clear walking route and seven visible unlock gates. In every zone, provide a shared object-collecting ground and evenly spaced open-sided personal factory plots that can expand to roughly 60×60 studs. A fully expanded plot holds one readable automated line with conveyors and 10 machine types: Crusher, Cutter, Melter, Press, Laser, Recycler, Duplicator, Rainbow Machine, Galaxy Machine, and Secret Machine. Reserve pickup sites for 13 object types: Apple, Toy, Rock, Glass, Diamond, Gold, Robot, Alien Crystal, Meteor, Black Hole, Rainbow Cube, Galaxy Core, and Secret Mystery Object. Include one egg pedestal and one shared event clearing in each zone.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Simulation.

## Shape and preset
Use `tier-ladder`: eight factory zones form a readable ordered sequence, each gated until progression unlocks it. Use the Tycoon preset with this tier-ladder shape instead of a shared team plot, retaining progression gates and circulation while making factory plots personal.

## Config requirements
Use seven `gate-progression` barriers between the eight zones. Use `path-circulation` for the continuous route through them. Use `resource-shared` for one shared collecting ground per zone. Use `physics-rig` for conveyors and all 10 processing machines. Use the visible half of `trigger-task` as each plot's object intake and processing line. Draw expandable 60×60-stud plot boundaries, eight egg pedestals, and eight event clearings as scene-specific geometry.

## Layout requirements
Place `collectible-nodes` throughout all eight shared collecting grounds, supporting the 13 named object types with frequent respawns. Place one scene-specific Plot claim marker and one `trigger-task` intake in every instantiated personal factory plot. Place eight scene-specific TriggerZone egg interactions and eight Spawner global-event origins, one of each per zone. Align seven scene-specific TriggerZone unlock checks to the seven visible `gate-progression` barriers; these free placements have no fitting canonical option IDs. Global event effects, pets, coins, upgrades, restart logic, collection book, leaderboard, sounds, and UI do not add further geometry.

## Layout components
The build contains exactly eight connected zones, seven gates, eight shared collecting grounds, eight egg pedestals, eight event clearings, and parametric per-player plots expanding to 60×60 studs. Each full plot supports 10 machine types on one production line; shared grounds support 13 object types. Keep the eight-zone order obvious from the Starter area to the Secret area.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: zone order, gates, shared grounds, plot spacing, and circulation must be authoritative before the eight themed visual treatments.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is huge, driven by eight areas and multiple 60×60-stud personal plots. The theme is colorful, polished, funny, and increasingly spectacular across candy, toy, technology, volcano, space, galaxy, and secret zones. Use `P0`; all zones coexist on one continuous, single-surface world with open-sided factories.
